scope: Allowed inputs, forbidden inputs and completion/cost rule of every comparison arm. 'arm' links a row to cm_experiments.protocol.ARMS; 'implementation' names the module that enforces the restriction. The generator checks both.

comparator.allowed: initial input x; development labels at selection time
comparator.forbidden: any intermediate measurement at evaluation time
comparator.completion: fixed schedule or plan-once sequence executed to its terminal depth; cost C_qC

mpc_ol.allowed: initial state H_0 and the consequence models at planning time
mpc_ol.forbidden: intermediate measurements after the plan is fixed
mpc_ol.completion: beyond the horizon H the plan is completed by the registered completion rule (nominal continuation to the terminal depth); cost charged in full

predictor.allowed: H_0 pooled, graph size and degree statistics; a network of the critic's parameter count; decoding over the registry with support masking
predictor.forbidden: actual intermediate measurements of the evaluated input; admission-oracle labels
predictor.completion: the decoded sequence is executed open loop; decoding cost charged in full; ϕ_x^seq and ϕ_x^gain reported separately (E2)

distilled.allowed: the feedback policy's executed sequences on D_explore as targets; the predictor's inputs at evaluation
distilled.forbidden: admission-oracle labels; intermediate measurements at evaluation
distilled.completion: executed open loop; student and execution cost charged

replanning.allowed: model-predicted states; the same search calls as MPC-RH
replanning.completion: replanning on predicted states with matched search calls, or the actual difference in work reported

feedback.allowed: intermediate measurements through the observer at every replanning site
feedback.completion: receding horizon with the same completion rule; cost C_expected, the observed per-input maximum and the modelled C_0.99 kept apart

budget.allowed: as MPC-RH, acquisitions gated by the certificate of Algorithm S3
budget.completion: Algorithm S3; acquisition rate, retained gain, late-abort rate, total work and latency tails reported; periodic, gap-trigger and learned triggers compared at the same actions and budget
